<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Bulma''' is the scientist of the Capsule Corporation. In DragonMineZ she waits next to [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta's Saiyan Pod|Vegeta's Saiyan Pod]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], takes the parts for every ship and radar in the story and gives more side quests than anyone else: the whole Capsule Corp line of gadgets, parts for your [[Special:MyLanguage/Vehicles|vehicles]] and a long list of errands.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding her == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Bulma is part of the structure: she is placed when [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta's Saiyan Pod|Vegeta's Saiyan Pod]] generates, in the rocky lands of Earth, next to [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]]. Use the Capsule Corp Assistant's maps or <code>/dmzlocate</code> to find the pod (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Bulma talks to every character, but if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is below 41 she greets you coldly and her side quests show as locked ("Requires an alignment of 41 or higher."). Her story quests and any side quest you have already started stay open. Below 25 she treats you as hostile. Server owners can change both limits in the NPC alignment rules (see [[Special:MyLanguage/NPC Placement and Alignment|NPC Placement and Alignment]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 14, ''Repairing the Saiyan Pod'': find Vegeta's Saiyan Pod and give Bulma 8 Blocks of Iron, 4 Blocks of Redstone and 4 Diamonds.
* Saiyan Saga quest 15, ''Prepare for Namek'': talk to Bulma; the reward is a Saiyan [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest 18, ''Gero's Blueprints'': bring her 16 Paper from [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero's Lab|Dr. Gero's Lab]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 38, ''Evacuate the City'': deliver 32 Bread and 24 Steak.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest 2, ''Parts for Bulma'': deliver radar pieces, redstone, iron and a Saiyan Space Pod; she gives you a [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]].
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]] quest 3, ''To the Demon Realm'': deliver Ender Pearls, Crying Obsidian, Blocks of Redstone and Amethyst Shards for the trip to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Side quests == <!--T:13-->
</translate>
{{Main|Sidequests}}
<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Most of Bulma's side quests belong to the '''Capsule Corp''' category: they build [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radars]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Scouters|scouters]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete tech]] and new [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] destinations. The rest are errands that send you around the world. Five of them reward the parts you need to build [[Special:MyLanguage/Vehicles|vehicles]]: ''Capsule Corp R&D'' and ''Alien Artifacts'' (a Vehicle Engine each), ''Comfortable Ride'' (2 Vehicle Seats), ''Rare Mineral Survey'' (2 Vehicle Plating) and ''Flight Stabilizer'' (a Vehicle Propeller).
</translate>
{{#invoke:Sidequests|giver|bulma}}
